_about: Ethyl lactate (1) + Methyl acetate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 93.32 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethyl lactate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: H. Matsuda, K. Inaba, H. Sumida, K. Kurihara, K. Tochigi, K. Ochi, Vapor-liquid equilibria of binary and ternary mixtures containing ethyl lactate and effect of ethyl lactate as entrainer, Fluid Phase Equilib. 420 (2016) 50-57
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 13. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.38 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
